The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] used '''Training Droids''' to teach new [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. [[Rhys Dallows]] destroyed one in the [[Naboo training canyon]] while working with [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]].
